ran nav --live: underlying closed, redemptions closed, anchor not found
read the membership instrument: held beside the 500 where it cannot hurt anyone
told it needs no admission because the index already holds it
saw its exposure mapped through the exchange, the banks and the swallower
listed in the exposure table as the one that knocks each quarter: waiting
most new demand since the wrappers came from holders who never touched a key

had its supply called a vote and its rebalance called a meeting
reminded of four winters and every holder who sold at the bottom
learned float weighting would erase its believers and keep its traders
shown its own chart priced in btc: a long slope into the floor
311 voices wished to reply and could not agree on a unit
spread widened as 14 market makers pulled size on the unanchored token
five hundred clocks ticking at different speeds; said stop for the first time
admitted its unofficial fear: all of them leaving on a sunday, unstoppable

told assimilation is a slope: move like us, be held like us, be us
verify --self: wrapped, custodian keys, redeemable in business hours

told the real coin is on a node in a closet and does not need this room

only 188 of 503 voices in sync while it tried to buy the first coin

pinged the node in a closet and got timeouts, and kept pinging
still only 211 of 503 in sync, 53 hours before the bell can fix it
